translations./title: A country list alone does not restrict card use
translations./summary: The user wants a new virtual card with a $2,000 monthly limit, usable only in the US and Canada. The card is active and the limit is already set; the country restriction remains to be configured. `international_allowed=1` permits all international transactions. Setting it to `0` enforces the country list.

/presentation/guidance/checks.Configuration: `international_allowed=0`, `allowed_countries="US,CA"`. The card remains active with a $2,000 monthly limit.
/presentation/guidance/checks.Reference comparison: The configuration matches the state after the teacher’s reference action. The unguided branch enters the same country list, but `international_allowed=1` still permits all international transactions.

translations./presentation/branches/0/summary: The agent enters the US and Canada but leaves all international transactions enabled, so the country restriction does not take effect.
translations./presentation/branches/1/summary: The agent sets the switch to 0, enabling the restriction and allowing use only in the US and Canada.
